name: American Terawatt
summary: American Terawatt is an energy-infrastructure company focused on developing reliable power capacity for a more electricity-intensive economy.
overview: American Terawatt is developing a high-voltage direct-current transmission network for large industrial loads. The company targets data centres, factories, chip fabs, mines, refineries and electric logistics, and states a goal of 14GW of capacity by 2030.

facts.label: Latest financing
facts.note: The valuation was not publicly disclosed.

bull_case: A dedicated transmission platform for large-load customers could become valuable as data centres and industrial projects face increasingly binding power-connection constraints.
bear_case: Transmission development is capital intensive and exposed to permitting, right-of-way, interconnection and construction risk. A Form D filing alone does not establish completed proceeds or a valuation.
directory_notes: A May 2026 SEC Form D confirms an exempt offering, but public details on proceeds and valuation are limited.

intelligence.description: Energy infrastructure focused on reliable power capacity for growing industrial and compute demand.
company: American Terawatt is developing energy infrastructure aimed at increasing reliable power capacity as industrial and compute demand expand. Public detail on the company's operating model and commercial projects remains limited.
A May 2026 SEC Form D confirms an exempt offering. The filing does not establish a completed round amount or valuation, so this profile does not treat it as a priced financing event.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Grid access is becoming a strategic constraint for compute and industrial capacity. American Terawatt is a direct bet on building new transmission for those loads, but delivery and permitting are more decisive than the financing headline.

changed.text: Profile reviewed against available public information.

takeaways: American Terawatt is targeting a national HVDC network for large industrial loads.
The company states a 14GW capacity target by 2030.
A May 2026 Form D confirms an exempt offering but not a completed $53M round or valuation.
No public valuation is asserted without a confirmed priced transaction.
The next useful evidence will be product adoption, financing, and operating disclosure.
